text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0}, on another stroll
with no real goal in mind, bumps into Ruka.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──その日特に予定もなく街を歩いていた
{0}はルカに出会った。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Enough already.
I'm not here to clean up your mess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい加減にしな。
自分の始末は自分でつけるんだね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Boss Lady! Don't abandon me!
I'm begging you here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと言わないでくださいよ姉御ぉ！
お願いしますっ！　この通り！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Quit calling me that! Sheesh. You're begging me?
This is just pathetic, so do me a favor and scra—
Oh, hey there. You been keeping well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御はよしな！　
ったく……この通りも何もないよ。
みっともないからさっさとどっかに……
おや、お前さん。
元気にしてるか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's good to hear.
...Curious about him, are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかい。
そいつは何よりだ。
……ああ、
こいつかい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
こいつか……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
He's just someone I gave a good scolding a while back.
Seems like he's gotten himself into a bit of trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にちょいと懲らしめてやったヤツさ。
ちょっとややこしい問題を抱えてるみたいでね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
A bit? A [i]bit[/i]?!
I just told you that I'm gonna be
six feet underground at this rate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとどころじゃないですよ！
さっきも言いましたけど俺、
このままだと殺されるんですよ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Even if I do go ahead and try to off their boss,
I'm gonna be dead meat either way... Haha...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもヤツらの頭領のタマ取りに行ったら、
どっちみち死ぬんですけどね……
ハハハ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Basically, this guy thought he'd finally left the gang he was in,
only to get an order to assassinate the boss of their rival group.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでも
こいつが抜けたと思ってたギャングのボスから、
抗争中の犯罪組織の頭領を暗殺しろ
って命令されちまったんだと。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
I never should have let the boss do me a favor.
They made it real clear what'll happen if I try to decline...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボスに借りを作っちまった俺が悪いんです……
断ったらタダじゃ済まないって脅されて……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
But I don't wanna live that life anymore! I wanna be clean!
Boss Lady helped me realize that!
That's why she's the only one I can rely on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でももう足を洗って、
堅気になって真面目に生きたいんです！
姉御のおかげで目が覚めたんです！
頼れるのは、
もう姉御しかいないんです！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Quit calling me that! Argh, fine.
Tell me where your boss is.
I'll discuss this with him directly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから姉御って呼ぶんじゃないよ！　
……仕方ないね。
ボスの居場所を教えな。
とりあえず、
そいつに直接話を聞きに行く。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Boss Lady! Thank you so much!
I'll never forget this debt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御ぉ！　
ありがとうございます！　
この恩は一生忘れません！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Let's not take it that far.
I'd just rather see you alive than dead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恩なんてもんじゃないよ。
アンタの死体をアタシが見たくないだけだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You sure about that? 
Well, it is a lot better than going alone.
Thanks. I appreciate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのかい？　
まあ
一人で行くよりは心強い。
よろしくな、
お前さん。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Heh. He went and did it.
Avoided turning up himself,
and even got someone else wrapped up in his business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……くくっ。
アイツめ。
顔を出すどころか、
まさか別人を寄越すとはな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You the boss around here, I take it?
I'm Ruka. A fishmonger in the business district.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタがここのボスかい？　
アタシはルカ。
繁華街の魚屋で働いてる。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
A fishmonger?! Hahahaha!
Now [i]this[/i] is priceless!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魚屋……？　
ハハハハハッ！　
こりゃ傑作だ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Let's cut to the chase.
Let him off already. He's not your underling anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
単刀直入に言うよ。
アイツを見逃しな。
もうアンタの部下じゃないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
No can do, I'm afraid.
Unless you run his little errand for him.
Then I'll think about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……タダじゃあ見逃せねぇ。
アンタが代わりにヤツの首を持ってきたら、
見逃してやろう。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? Why should I have to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？　
なんでアタシが……

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
He asked you for help, didn't he?!
Then it's your job to clean up his mess!
That's how we do things around here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──アイツがお前に助けを求めたんだろうが！
だったらお前が尻拭いするのが筋ってもんだろ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's how you do things, is it? $By taking advantage of others?
text_block_list.orig_text:
筋だって？　
弱みにつけ込んでるだけのくせによく言うよ……

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Never thought he'd turn to a regular ass fishmonger, though.
Heh heh... Pathetic! You're nothing!
The only thing you can slice up is fish, ain't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしよりにもよって、
ただの魚屋の女に頼むとはなぁ……
くくくっ。
なぁ！　
アンタに何が出来るんだ？
どうせ三枚に下ろすのは魚だけだろ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You'd be wise not to underestimate me.
You know what? I [i]will[/i] do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……魚屋の女をなめんじゃないよ。
そこまで言うならやってやろうじゃないか！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Give it your best shot, little miss fishmonger!
Not that it'll get you anywhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出来るもんなら是非ともやってもらおうじゃねぇか！
まあ魚屋には土台無理な話だろうがなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though.
I'll be there to collect the pieces when it's all over!
Hahahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心しな！　
ドジ踏んでも骨は拾ってやるよ！　
ハッハッハッハッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Let's hope you're as enthusiastic when I get the job done.
I'll be back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……首見てたまげても知らないよ。
邪魔したね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
Why'd I go and do that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
はぁ。
やっちまった。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Member
text_block_list.text:
Hey, kiddo! Your mommy's back! Ain't that great?
Now you can stop pissing your pants! Hyahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい兄ちゃん！　
姉ちゃん出て来たぞ。よかったなぁ！
もうビビんなくて済むぞ！　
ヒャハハハッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I shouldn't have let you wait around here.
Let's get going. I'll fill you in on the way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん。
こんなところで待たせて悪かったね。
行こうか。
詳しくは歩きながら話すよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
And that's the gist of it.
I'm stuck having to do the job for him now.
I kind of lost my cool after their boss ridiculed my job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ってなわけで、
結局アタシが仕事を肩代わりする羽目になっちまった。
仕事をバカにされちまったもんだから、
つい勢いでね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You could call it a personality quirk, I suppose.
But this time I definitely took it a bit too far.
text_block_list.orig_text:
性分とはいえ、
さすがに今回は反省してるよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Here's hoping I can diffuse the situation between
both parties, at the very least.
choice_data_list: They should really just go at it themselves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤツらがいがみ合ってるのを、
上手く解決出来たらいいんだけどね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If they're enemies, then it should be between them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
敵同士勝手にやってくれるのが一番だ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
That'd be the ideal solution, but alas.
I can't believe how willing they are to get others involved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通りだよ。
無関係の人間をいちいち巻き込むなんて酷い話だよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If they both got rid of each other...
Wait. That's it. There's no need
for us to get our hands dirty with their business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせなら相打ちに……
それだ。
何もアタシたちが手を汚す必要なんてないんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If we get both parties' bosses together,
then they'll just hash it out on their own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頭同士を引き合わせたら、
後は勝手に潰し合ってくれるはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Which makes our goal nice and simple.
First up, we need to locate the other boss.
text_block_list.orig_text:
となれば、
やることは一つだね……
まずは頭領を見つけよう。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so Ruka begins searching for the opposing faction's boss.
Eventually she digs up info on a place he visits often, and she
and {0} make their way there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後ルカは、敵対組織の頭領を探した。
やがて頭領がよく顔を出す場所の情報を手に入れた
ルカと{0}は、その場所へ向かった。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
That looks like our target.
I'll take care of this, so you watch my back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうやらアイツが頭領だね。
お前さんは見張りを頼む。
行くよっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You're coming with me!
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょいと顔貸してもらうよ！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text: And who the hell are you?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだテメェら！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっ！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text: Gurgh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐえっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That went nice and smoothly.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……成功だね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Guess who's back!
text_block_list.orig_text: 邪魔するよ！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. So? Couldn't go through with it, could you?
I know someone running with their tail between their legs when I see—
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタか……
どうせ逃げてきたんだろ？　
まあオレには分かってた──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I brought the opposition's boss right to you.
Now it's up to the two of you to settle this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
向こうの頭領を連れて来たよ！
あとはアンタたちの好きなようにしな！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
text_block_list.orig_text: うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text: The hell?! I never asked for this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだと！？　
オレはこんなこと頼んでないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
Where am I... Wait! So you're behind this?! You god damn fool!
Guess you want your whole group to go under!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここは……
はっ！
　
テメェの仕業か！
ふざけた真似しやがって！　
組織がどうなってもいいんだろうな！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
This is a big misunderstanding! Th-that's right! I actually wanna form an alliance!
That'll help both our groups grow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはな、ちょっとした手違いだ！
　
……そ、そうだよ！
俺はアンタと組織拡大のため、
同盟を結ぼうと思っていたんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: WHAT?!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
W-well, whaddya know! I've actually been thinking the same!
We're just gonna wipe each other out if we keep this up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにぃ～っ！？
……そ、そうか！　
実はウチもそう思ってたとこなんだよ！
このままケンカしてても、
お互いが潰れちまうだけだしな！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Now hear me out. All this? She set it all up!
She's the one that's been driving us to war!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだろそうだろ！
だからな……
これは、
この女が勝手にやったことだ！
この女が、
俺たちを争わせた真犯人なんだ！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
Well, that explains things. So you're the culprit, huh?!
Been trying to get in our way all this time, have ya?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったのか……
今回の騒動の原因はテメェか！
オレたちが手を組んでデカくなるのを邪魔するつもりだったんだな！

text_block_list.name: Gang Member
text_block_list.text: Boss! We're here to make the save!
text_block_list.orig_text:
頭領！　
助けに来ましたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
Good timing!
We've got one enemy here! That woman!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
ヤツらは敵じゃねぇ！　
敵はあの女とガキだ！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Member
text_block_list.text: So we just gotta take her down?
text_block_list.orig_text: ボス、この女を倒せばいいんですね！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Aye! Plus the little runt with her!
Make sure to lock the door, just in case.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
ついでに横のガキも一緒に消しちまえ！
ドアの鍵はちゃんとかけとけよ……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. No rest for the wicked, eh?
Pitiful. Laughable, even.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やれやれ。
これが悪人の悪知恵か。
ろくでもないね。
笑っちまうよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You get out of here. I'll take them all on myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんは逃げな。
ここはアタシ一人でなんとかするよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...Got it. Always love it when you show that vigor!
Let me borrow that power of yours again!
Now then. I'm going to have to go all out now, aren't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お前さん。
その心意気、気に入った！
また貸してもらうよ、その力！　
……やれやれ、参ったな。
コイツはアタシも、
本気で応えないといけないね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You small fry won't last a second.
I was hoping to settle this as quietly as possible, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アンタたちくらいの雑魚、
どうにでも出来たんだ。
なるべく穏便に済ませようと思ってたのに……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me for what happens to you now!
If you've got a death wish, then come at me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっから先は全員どうなっても知らないよ！
死にたい奴だけ
かかってきな！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the?! How'd she become so threatening?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、なんだ！？　
この女、急に凄みが……！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
That killing intent is off the charts! Hey, woman!
Just who the hell are you?! An assassin sent by him?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
殺気が半端じゃねぇ……！　
おいテメェ！
ホントは何モンだ！？　
アイツが雇った殺し屋か！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Like I said. I'm just a fishmonger.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントも何も、
ただの魚屋のバイトさ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
A fishmonger that also happens to be
Twilight Caravan's guildmaster too, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ついでに、
トワイライトキャラバンのギルドマスターもやってるけどね。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
T-Twilight Caravan?!
Hahaha... You're kidding, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ト、
トワイライトキャラバンだぁ！？
ハハハ、
ウソだろ……？
　なぁ？

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Member
text_block_list.text: Boss, is that the guild I think it is?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボス、
今のってまさか……！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
You're damn right. The've got the One-Eyed Devil. And not
just her! The Collector, the Destroyer, even the Living Storm...
They're the most dangerous guild in Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『隻眼の悪魔』……
それだけじゃない！　『蒐集家』も！
『壊し屋』に『歩く竜巻』まで所属してる、
この街で一番やべえギルドじゃねぇか……！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Yet their guildmaster's never shown their face in the underworld!
All I'd heard is they were strong enough to control that insane crew!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなのに、ギルドマスターだけが裏社会に一切姿を現さない……！
ソイツらを従えられるだけの凄腕って話だったが……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Control? Please. As if they'd ever listen to anyone.
I just had the position forced on me.
I'm a fishmonger, first and foremost. Now and forever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
従える？　
アイツらが人に従うわけないだろ？
役割を押しつけられただけさ。
アタシは今でも……
ただの魚屋だよ。

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Dammit!
I can't believe he sent a monster like this after us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちくしょう！　
アイツめ、
なんてのを寄越しやがったんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
E-everyone bail!
We don't stand a chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
に、
逃げるぞ！　
勝てるわけがねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! We'll rule the underworld if we can take her down!
Go get her, boys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや！　
ここでコイツを倒せばオレらが裏社会に君臨出来るんだ！
テメェらやれ！　
やっちまえ！

text_block_list.name: Baddies
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おおおおおおおっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. Why do you petty villains always make it a point to
come at me in droves? If I need to beat some sense into
those thick skulls, then so be it! You best be ready!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく……
悪人どもが寄ってたかって、
毎度よくもまぁ群れやがって……
その性根ごと、
叩き斬ってやるよ！　
覚悟しな！

text_block_list.name: Baddies
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaghhh! H-help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃあああああっ！　
た、助けてえええええっ！

text_block_list.name: Knight
text_block_list.text:
We received reports of a commotion at a nearby restaurant, but...
Just what in the world happened here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
飲食店で騒ぎが起こったという通報があったはずなんだが……
一体、
何があったんだ……！？

text_block_list.name: Knight
text_block_list.text: I-I can't even begin to fathom this situation...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こ、これは、
どういう状況だ？

text_block_list.name: Syndicate Boss
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, Boss Lady! I was in the wrong all this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御！　
オレぁ……
オレぁ今まで間違ってました！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I told you to quit calling me that! Knock it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから姉御じゃないって言ってるだろ！？　
いい加減にしな！

text_block_list.name: Gang Boss
text_block_list.text:
Don't be like that!
We're your loyal subordinates, from now until the end of time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと言わないでください！
これからはオレたち、
姉御に一生ついていきます！

text_block_list.name: Baddies
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady! Boss Lady!
text_block_list.orig_text: あ・ね・ご！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Argh! Why does it always end up like this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁもう！　
結局こうなっちまう！

text_block_list.name: Knight
text_block_list.text: Um... Can we inquire as to what's going on here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの～、
何があったんですか……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Royal knights! Perfect! You guys can handle this lot!
As for us, let's get going! Farewell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁそこの騎士さん！　
コイツらのことは任せたよ！　
じゃあね！
お前さん！　行くよ！

text_block_list.name: Baddies
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady! Hold up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってくださいよ～！　
姉御ぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*
Think we managed to get away... You okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、はぁ、はあぁ……
どうにか逃げられたね……
お前さん、
平気か？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
They're not the first people to say they've turned over a new leaf.
The thing is, though, this never really leads to good results.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああやって目が覚めたって言ってるヤツらはさ、
ちょっと目が眩んでるだけなんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
All of my admirers have ended up pushing
themselves way more than they need to, only to reach their
limit at the end of it all. Don't you turn out the same way, okay?
choice_data_list: It's not my goal to take down baddies.
Even if I wanted to do, I couldn't.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシに憧れたバカは、
無茶を繰り返して、
いつかみんな壊れちまうんだ……
お前さんは、
アイツらみたいになるんじゃないよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Figures.
You'd have joined the royal guard if that were the case, wouldn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だろうね。
そんなことがしたけりゃ、
今頃騎士団にでも入ってるか……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Fair enough.
Strength itself isn't what's important to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもそうか。
お前さんは、
強さそのものには執着してないからね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Let me ask, then. What made you come with me?
choice_data_list: I just wanted to help you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあお前さんは、
何のためにアタシについてきたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
So it wasn't about putting an end to warring factions,
or even a sense of justice?
You just did it for my sake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アタシのため？　
じゃあ組織の対立だの、
悪人を懲らしめるなんて、
それこそ端から眼中になかったのか……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haha... Ahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ……
ふふふっ、
あはははっ！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I swear. You really are a great guy!
I like you even more now!
I'm counting on you from here on out, partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんは、
本っ当にいい男だね！
ますます気に入ったよ！　
これからも頼りにしてるよ、
お前さん！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With a light smack on the back and her firm words,
Ruka's trust in {0} made itself more than apparent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──軽く背中を叩いたルカの言葉と手の感触から、
{0}は確かな信頼を感じたのだった。
